A refreshed Home screen puts tools before recent documents. Customize lets you reorder or hide sections and remembers your layout.
Redesigned Settings with visual previews and two new styles: Studio, the new default, and Sage.
Draw with finger can be enabled or disabled independently of mouse input. Added long-press page menus, a floating touch toolbar, and icon-color previews in Settings.

A compact touch icon opens contextual settings for target size, long-press delay, finger-stroke smoothing, gesture hints, and the floating toolbar. Settings offers Automatic, Touch, and Mouse only modes.
Clicking existing text opens its editor even with the Text tool active. Clicking outside finishes the current edit and keeps changes; a separate click starts the next edit.
